output.evaluation_note: The English 'essay' (in its common pedagogical sense of a short analytical/argumentative piece of writing) does not align with Japanese '論文' (ronbun) or Vietnamese 'luận văn'. Both '論文' and 'luận văn' primarily refer to a 'thesis' or 'dissertation' – a much more substantial and formal academic work. For a general 'essay', more appropriate translations would be Japanese '小論文' (shōronbun) or '作文' (sakubun), and Vietnamese 'bài luận'. The provided English definition is also overly broad for a 'core learning sense'.
